title: Abstract Ethical Concepts with Neuter Lo
goal: Name moral and philosophical categories with neuter lo + adjective, lo + participle, and lo + adjective + de + noun.
grammar: neuter lo + ethical/logical adjective, lo + past participle, and lo + adjective + de + noun

items: I can use neuter lo + masculine singular adjective and lo + past participle to name abstract ethical categories (lo justo, lo lícito, lo debido).
I can frame philosophical tensions with lo + adjective + de + noun without making lo agree with a following noun.
I can use foundational philosophy vocabulary (la filosofía, moral, racional, verdadero, subjetivo, paradójico, lícito).
